description:
Jingle Bells: How Sleigh Runners Glide Across Packed Snow! — Jingle bells, jingle bells, jingle all the way! Oh what fun it is to ride in a one-horse open sleigh! But how do heavy sleighs glide over deep snow without sinking?
Kids science answer for "jingle bells song for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Instead of narrow wheels that dig into powdery snow, sleighs have long, polished curved runners that spread weight over a large surface area and glide on a melted water film created by friction.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
